reading: French President Emmanuel Macron has warned that Russia's hybrid attacks against Europe have grown more intense.
He stated that France has been affected by these attacks in recent weeks.
Macron explained that he had ordered a plan to secure essential infrastructure and defense sites.
A growing number of European leaders believe Russia may be testing their commitment to supporting Ukraine.
The French president recently discussed the security impact of conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine with party leaders.
He mentioned remarks by Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk suggesting Russia was planning drone and missile strikes against countries on Nato's eastern flank.
Macron stated that the intent behind these actions is to intimidate Europeans and break their efforts to support Ukraine.
He stressed that France would not be intimidated because European security is at stake in Ukraine.
Prime Minister Tusk said there was a "real risk" of such strikes on Nato territory, which Moscow might claim were "accidental" to split the alliance.
Last Sunday, a Russian drone hit a passenger train near the Ukraine-Poland border, shortly after European security officials had passed through.
Hybrid warfare is a strategy combining military force with non-military methods like misinformation and economic pressure.
Macron also addressed the energy situation, announcing a G7 meeting to discuss energy issues and raise the question of gas stocks.

to make someone feel frightened or nervous so that they will do what you want.
at risk; in danger of being lost.
a group of countries or organizations that have agreed to work together.
a careful plan or method for achieving a particular goal.
false or inaccurate information that is spread, often unknowingly.

entries.ja: 何かによって影響を受けたり、変化したりすること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것에 의해 영향을 받거나 변화되는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 受到某事物影响或改变。

entries.ja: 誰かに何かをするよう命じたり、指示したりすること。
entries.ko: 누군가에게 어떤 일을 하도록 명령하거나 지시하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 命令或指示某人做某事。
entries.es: Mandar o instruir a alguien para que haga algo.
entries.pt-BR: Comandar ou instruir alguém para fazer algo.

entries.ja: 何かをすることを約束したり、固く決意したりすること。
entries.zh-Hans: 做某事的承诺或坚定决定。
entries.es: Una promesa o decisión firme de hacer algo.
entries.pt-BR: Uma promessa ou decisão firme de fazer algo.

entries.ja: 何かがもたらす強い効果や影響。
entries.ko: 어떤 것이 미치는 강한 효과나 영향.
entries.zh-Hans: 某事物产生的强烈影响或效果。
entries.es: El fuerte efecto o influencia que algo tiene.
entries.pt-BR: O forte efeito ou influência que algo tem.

entries.ja: 何かについてのコメントや発言。
entries.zh-Hans: 对某事物的评论或陈述。

entries.ja: 誰かを怖がらせたり不安にさせたりして、自分の思い通りにさせようとすること。
entries.ko: 누군가를 겁먹게 하거나 불안하게 만들어 당신이 원하는 것을 하도록 만드는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 使某人感到害怕或紧张，从而使其听从你的意愿。
entries.es: Hacer que alguien se sienta asustado o nervioso para que haga lo que quieres.
entries.pt-BR: Fazer alguém sentir medo ou nervosismo para que faça o que você quer.

entries.ja: 危険にさらされている、失われる恐れがあること。
entries.zh-Hans: 有风险；面临失去的危险。
entries.es: En riesgo; en peligro de perderse.
entries.pt-BR: Em risco; em perigo de ser perdido.

entries.ja: 協力して活動することに同意した国々や組織の集まり。
entries.zh-Hans: 一群已同意共同合作的国家或组织。
entries.es: Un grupo de países u organizaciones que han acordado trabajar juntos.
entries.pt-BR: Um grupo de países ou organizações que concordaram em trabalhar juntos.

entries.ja: 特定の目標を達成するための慎重な計画や方法。
entries.ko: 특정 목표를 달성하기 위한 신중한 계획이나 방법.
entries.zh-Hans: 实现特定目标的周密计划或方法。
entries.es: Un plan o método cuidadoso para lograr un objetivo particular.
entries.pt-BR: Um plano ou método cuidadoso para alcançar um objetivo específico.

entries.ja: 誤って、しばしば無意識のうちに広められる虚偽または不正確な情報。
entries.ko: 자신도 모르게 퍼지는 거짓되거나 부정확한 정보.
entries.zh-Hans: 被传播的虚假或不准确的信息，通常是在不知情的情况下。
entries.es: Información falsa o inexacta que se difunde, a menudo sin saberlo.
entries.pt-BR: Informação falsa ou imprecisa que é espalhada, muitas vezes sem saber.
